headline: Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating Fed's inflation fight
detail: This inflation report is the main driver today. Higher-than-expected CPI means the Fed might keep rates higher for longer, which is bad for growth stocks like your tech holdings. This could put more pressure on your leveraged ETFs.
rec: Consider trimming leveraged positions like SOXL and MU given the inflation news.

headline: Why stocks are falling and 10-year yields are back near 5% after Tuesday’s inflation report
detail: Rising yields are the enemy of tech stocks, especially those trading on margin. This headline confirms the market's reaction to the inflation data, suggesting a risk-off environment that will likely continue to pressure your concentrated tech book.
rec: No action based on this headline alone, but it reinforces the need to monitor your leveraged positions closely.

headline: Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X - leveraged, decays; default stop, adjust to taste
detail: This is a note about SOXL, one of your largest losers (-75.55%). Leveraged ETFs decay over time, and this is clearly happening here, amplified by the current market conditions. The default stop is very high, suggesting it's not being actively managed.
rec: Re-evaluate the stop on SOXL. Given the -75.55% PnL and leverage, consider a tighter stop to prevent further catastrophic losses.
